req.title: Redirect to arbitrary URL
req.statement: The system shall issue an HTTP 302 redirect to the URL given by the 'url' query parameter of /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to() handler reads 'url' from query args, sets status_code=302 by default, and writes the exact URL string into the Location header. To maximise mutation kill rate I need to: (1) assert status_code == 302 exactly (catches constant mutations); (2) assert Location == the exact supplied URL string (catches string-copy mutations); (3) test with a custom 3xx status_code to cover the branch `if status_code >= 300 and status_code < 400`; (4) test boundary values 299 and 400 for the status_code guard (catches >= vs > and < vs <=); (5) test missing 'url' parameter (negative path, KeyError); (6) test a URL containing special/unicode characters to verify UTF-8 encoding path; (7) test that a non-3xx status_code is ignored and 302 is returned.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_basic_302
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: status 302 and Location set to supplied url
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_basic_302():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com'

test_redirect_to_basic_302()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_location_exact_match
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: Location must equal the exact url query parameter value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_location_exact_match():
    target = 'http://httpbin.org/get'
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + target)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == target
    assert r.headers['Location'] != ''
    assert r.headers['Location'] != '/redirect/1'

test_redirect_to_location_exact_match()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_url_with_query_string_preserved
expected: Location header contains the full URL with query string intact
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: Location must be the exact url value including embedded query parameters
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_url_with_query_string_preserved():
    target = 'https://example.com/path?foo=bar'
    import urllib.parse
    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(target, safe='')
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + encoded)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == target

test_redirect_to_url_with_query_string_preserved()

trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: default status code constant is 302; catches mutations to 301/303/200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_default_is_302_not_301_or_303():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_unicode_url
actions: Send GET /redirect-to with a URL containing unicode characters percent-encoded
expected: Location header equals the decoded unicode URL
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: handler encodes url value as UTF-8 into Location; unicode URLs must survive round-trip
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import urllib.parse
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_unicode_url():
    target = 'https://example.com/élève'
    encoded_target = urllib.parse.quote(target, safe=':/?#[]@!$&\'()*+,;=')
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + urllib.parse.quote(target, safe=''))
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc = r.headers['Location']
    assert loc == target or urllib.parse.unquote(loc) == target

test_redirect_to_unicode_url()
